messages:
Claire P (partnerships): hey team :wave: need updated inputs from our hardware suppliers for the Q3 cost model. specifically: reserved commit tiers, spot availability %, typical lead times, and any minimums. can you paste ranges here or drop the CSV into the shared drive? cc @Leo H

Ajay R (FP&A): Quick clarifying q's: please give both list price and committed (discounted) price per GPU-hour, and any region splits (us-east / eu-north / ap-south). also call out any extra adders (egress, storage, kms) if known.

Leo H (HW Sales): from vendor side (non-confidential ranges): A800 series - spot avail 35-55% across regions (lower in ap-south). reserved terms: 1/3/12 months with approx 10%/18%/28% off list. min commit: 10 GPUs for 1mo, 2 GPUs steady-state for 12mo. list/spot figures below. lead times + procurement notes coming.

Naiya S (Infra Ops): do we want to normalize hours/month (730) and factor patching downtime? i'd add a ~3% maintenance buffer. also flag region capacity skew when modeling.

Ajay R (FP&A): good call Naiya. also need billing granularity (per-hour vs per-minute) and SLA credit mechanics for reserved vs spot. those change effective cost.

Claire P (partnerships): @Leo can you paste the non-sensitive price bands here? if sensitive, paste discount % and spot churn stats. i'll put everything into the model_inputs tab.

Leo H (HW Sales): non-sensitive price bands: 
- A800: list ~$1.50/hr, reserved effective range $1.35 -> $1.05/hr (term dependent), spot ~$0.60 -> $0.90/hr.
- H100: list ~$3.50/hr, reserved ~$3.20 -> $2.60/hr, spot ~$1.20 -> $2.10/hr.
avg spot preemption windows: 30-90 minutes. lead time for reserved capacity: ~4-6 weeks for large orders, smaller commits ~1-2 weeks. vendors also note seasonal procurement spikes in Q4.

Ajay R (FP&A): perfect. for modeling i'm going to assume: 730 hours/mo, reserved util 95% (dedicated workloads), spot base util 45% with avg eviction rate 15% -> model capacity churn and fallback cost. i'll add fields for contract start, SLA credits, billing granularity.

Claire P (partnerships): sample CSV header i added to the sheet and pasting here so folks have a common format:
region,gpu_type,commit_term_months,discount_pct,list_usd_per_hr,spot_usd_per_hr,avg_spot_avail_pct,min_commit_gpus,lead_time_weeks

Claire P (partnerships): sample row:
us-east,A800,12,28,1.50,0.75,45,2,6

Leo H (HW Sales): can share exact monthly pricing privately with procurement/legal. public thread ranges above are safe. i'll ping procurement to get contract templates + SLA language. will drop final CSV to the drive and tag Claire by EOD.

deploy-bot: file uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/partners/q3_partner_inputs.csv (uploaded by Leo H)

Naiya S (Infra Ops): one more modeling note: private/on-prem deployments often include KMS/HSM adders from vendors — typically +$0.15-0.25/hr. add that as a separate line item for Private customers.

Ajay R (FP&A): noted. i'll produce three scenarios (base / optimistic / pessimistic) and include sensitivity to spot eviction and lead-time delays. aim to share morning tomorrow.

Claire P (partnerships): awesome, thanks everyone :tada: any other vendor-specific quirks (eg minimum term penalties, early termination fees) please call them out in the sheet.

Leo H (HW Sales): will do. thumbs up :+1:

Ajay R (FP&A): +1

Naiya S (Infra Ops): thanks, that helps a lot.
